final: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.throws AS throwing_hand, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM player_award AS a JOIN player AS p ON a.player_id = p.player_id COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY p.throws), totals AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM hand_counts), shares AS (SELECT h.throwing_hand, h.record_count, 1.0 * h.record_count / t.total_count AS share FROM hand_counts AS h JOIN totals AS t ON t.total_count IS NOT NULL), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.record_count), AVG(s.share), AVG(s.share - a.value) FROM shares AS s JOIN average_share AS a ON a.value IS NOT NULL WHERE s.share > a.value
